clauses.title: Room Rent Limitation
clauses.text: Eligible room rent shall be limited to the percentage of Sum Insured specified in the policy schedule. Where the insured occupies a room above the eligible limit, applicable proportional deductions may apply to associated medical expenses as specified by the policy.

clauses.title: Non-Payable Items
clauses.text: Expenses relating to specified non-medical and administrative consumables shall not be payable where excluded under the applicable policy terms.

clauses.title: Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period
clauses.text: Expenses related to declared pre-existing diseases may be subject to the waiting period specified in the applicable policy schedule.

clauses.title: Maximum Liability
clauses.text: The insurer's liability shall not exceed the available Sum Insured and applicable policy limits.

clauses.title: Cashless Pre-Authorization
clauses.text: Cashless treatment is subject to pre-authorization, policy coverage, medical necessity, and verification of applicable exclusions and limits.

clauses.title: Discharge Claim Assessment
clauses.text: Final discharge assessment shall consider actual treatment rendered, eligible expenses, applicable deductions, policy limits, and supporting documents.

clauses.title: Misrepresentation and Fraud
clauses.text: Material inconsistencies, duplicate billing, artificial unbundling, fabricated documentation, or other suspicious patterns may result in investigation or query.

clauses.title: Critical Illness Coverage
clauses.text: Critical illness benefits are payable subject to the defined covered conditions, diagnosis requirements, waiting periods, and policy limits.

clauses.title: Senior Citizen Coverage
clauses.text: Senior citizen claims shall be evaluated against the applicable policy schedule, co-payment provisions, waiting periods, exclusions, and admissibility rules.

clauses.title: Family Floater Sum Insured
clauses.text: The available Sum Insured is shared among covered members of the family floater policy and shall be reduced by eligible claims during the policy year.
